_note: Shared numbers for every villager (data/villagers/<id>.json; files starting with _ are not villagers). walk_speed is in cells per game minute (a minute is 0.5 s, so 1.5 = 3 cells a second, a bit slower than the farmer's 3.75); a villager's own speed wins. stride: cells walked per walk frame (4 frames = two steps). Ours, picked by eye.
_work: A {"work": minutes} step in a day plan (Hachiro building on the farm) shows the work pose: hammer up, then the blow, work_strokes_per_minute blows a game minute (2 = one every 0.25 s, a steady carpenter's beat; ours, by eye). Each blow knocks (Sfx build_knock) when the farmer is on that map.
_fish: A {"fish": minutes} step (Kota and Hachiro at the river on a fair Sunday) shows the fish pose: a rod held out, the line down from its tip; the tip dips for one game minute in every fish_bob_minutes (a nibble now and then; ours, by eye).
_delay: A talk turns the villager to the farmer and they stand talk_turn_minutes after it closes; walking into the farmer (within bump_reach cells, heading their way) makes them wait. Both push their plan back, at most delay_max minutes, cleared at 12:00 and 18:00 (DESIGN: villagers). The farmer can't step closer than block_reach cells to anyone. Ours.
_affection: How much each villager likes the farmer: 0 .. max, starting at start. A talk counts once a day (talk), a gift once a day by the villager's reaction (gift; lists in each villager's gifts). bands: the affection where each of the 7 heart colours starts, 0 = a stranger, 6 = a dear friend; dialogue picks and event rows use the band, not the number. Our numbers: a daily talk alone reaches band 3 by the end of the first year, a loved gift a day gets there in about a season. birthday_times: a gift on the villager's birthday (birthday in their file) counts that many times, good or bad (DESIGN: x5). neglect: each night, a villager the farmer has met (affection above 0) who got neither a talk nor a gift that day loses loss with odds chance (DESIGN: 1 in 10 for 1); ours is 1 in 8, so a whole season away costs about 4 points, a fifth of the first band: forgetting someone shows, but never undoes a year.
